course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: The field says 77. Why does the database still say 30?
goal: Observe 77 in form/object buffers while the persisted document remains 30.

prerequisites.text: onec.p7; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: A question before observation
paragraphs: You edited the minutes in an open request. The screen shows the new number, but has it been saved? Follow three sources for one field without pressing Save.

sections.title: Forms hold a representation
paragraphs: A managed form has attributes and controls; an application object has logic and persisted state. Form values can be intermediate and unsaved. Equal field names do not create one variable in every context. Trace where minutes came from and when they become a persisted document value.

Start from an own saved 30-minute document and retain its reference. Edit to 77 without Save/Post. Distinguish form data, the converted object and the earlier persisted record. Equal buffer values do not prove persistence.

sections.title: Continue your own form
paragraphs: Continue your own separate copy with Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги. The code belongs in the managed УчебнаяФормаЗаявки module, not a common module or startup handler. The form already contains Объект. Append only missing methods; do not duplicate existing definitions or load a full CF over your work.

In the form attributes add ИтогОпыта: String(120) and ВерсияЗапроса: Number(10,0). These belong to the form, not the document. The duplicate-reply task additionally needs ОбработаннаяВерсия and РасчетовОпыта: Number(10,0), initially 0.

In the form editor create the command ПоказатьБуфер, select its existing procedure as the action, and place it on the command bar. Append Команда.bsl to the same form module; do not generate a duplicate empty procedure. Link СверитьНовуюЗаявку similarly for the independent task.

Worked setup: open your own saved 30-minute request. For buffer/directive observations set 77 without saving; the callback command sets 90 and version 2 itself. The server experiment explicitly supplies 90, 1441, and the string “90”.

sections.title: Methods for the worked experiment
paragraphs: Only methods needed for this experiment are shown. If a previous topic already added a method, retain its single definition. The course retains the original complete module.

sections.title: The client command and its actual output
paragraphs: Your saved request contains 30 minutes. Change the open form buffer to 77. СверитьБуфер converts the form data into a document object and independently rereads the reference: the first two values are 77, the persisted value is 30. Conversion does not call Записать.

sections.title: Conversion is explicit
paragraphs: On the server, FormAttributeToValuecan obtain an application object from a suitable form attribute. Returning data also requires proper conversion. Do not assume form data exposes every object method. Identify actual type and allowed context rather than moving everything to the client to silence an error.

СверитьБуфер belongs to the managed form module with &НаСервере. РеквизитФормыВЗначение with the attribute name «Объект» converts current form data; ПолучитьОбъект through Объект.Ссылка independently rereads persisted state. No write method is called.

sections.title: Predict before running
paragraphs: What will an independent reference read return before saving?
sections.reveal: 30. Form data and the converted object can agree while the persisted record remains unchanged. The third observation is independent because it is reread through the reference.

sections.title: UI validation does not protect writes
paragraphs: The form may highlight bad ranges before submission, but the object boundary must enforce mandatory rules. Client data can become stale between read and write. Important operations need an agreed server-side version/state check. A new screen must not bypassP5preservation rules.

Add an own Сверить command whose action calls the function and prints all three fields separately. Each observation must name its source. Replacing rereading with the same form value would invalidate independence.

sections.title: Follow the source and action boundary
paragraphs: Arrows follow observation sources, not automatic saves. The independent task uses different values: 135 / 135 / 60.

flow.caption: Arrows follow observation sources, not automatic saves. The independent task uses different values: 135 / 135 / 60.

sections.title: The mistake this experiment distinguishes
paragraphs: Replace the independent read with another form-field read and all three values become 77. This establishes no save: all observations now come from one buffer. Restore the independent read instead of adjusting the expectation.

sections.title: Test two routes
paragraphs: Create a valid request through the form and programmatically; outcomes should agree. Submit invalid data by both routes. Reopen and compare fields. If presentation is stale, refresh it through the agreed event rather than rewriting the database merely to synchronize the screen.

Close without saving and reopen the same reference: expect 30. In a different copy test ordinary saving of 77 and rereading. Module 5 direct writes remain an independent route for object validation; never use another learner’s document.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Use a separate new request already saved with 60 minutes. Once open, change only its buffer to 135. Add a client command that calls СверитьБуфер and prints Form, Object, and Database separately. Close without saving and reopen the same reference. Preserve the earlier 30-minute request and methods.
Preserve your prediction and code before viewing the reference. The worked example does not solve this new task. Viewing its files does not replace your work.

sections.title: The actual training 1C window
paragraphs: The yellow area is the installed 1C interface; the Nexus lesson remains matte. A command driver calls the same managed form, without a real account or other infobases.

sections.title: What was established and what you explain
paragraphs: A local file infobase establishes the chosen branches and contexts, not network latency, clustering, all permissions, or learner understanding. Record direct callbacks and physical dialog interaction separately.
Explain why converting data and matching two values do not establish a save.
